lede: How the client computes a hit's damage: what multiplies what, and what's worth upgrading.
caveat: Read from the 1.5.002 client's code. The server-side constants aren't in the client and still need measuring.

you.summary: Feed the emptiest bucket: skill amp, boss DMG, final DMG and crit each multiply damage.
changes: Weigh a skill amp point at 1% ÷ (1 + your total amp).
Keep Skill AMP on buffers: it grows every amp-scaled buff they give.
Crit: raise whichever of effective crit rate (crit rate − target crit RES) and crit DMG is lower.
Don't pick weapon lines by crit-rate digits.
Test Light against Fire on the Piñata before trusting its weakness.
